name: Dev Jhawar
role: I build agentic AI systems and the backend infrastructure they run on.
bio: I'm a final-year CS student at KIIT who likes the part of software nobody screenshots: queues, retries, retrieval pipelines and the agents that sit on top of them.

Most of what I build is an LLM system that has to behave in production: research agents that cite what they read, RAG that points at the exact clause it used, and schedulers that survive a Redis flush.
Lately I've been sending fixes upstream to the tools I use, like Kubeflow, Prefect, Docling and OpenLLMetry.
